info.title: SoulRipper
info.description: Rips the music, jingles and sound effects of NES and Game Boy ROMs to VGM files, with no per-game setup: it finds the game's sound requests by itself and names the tracks from community rips.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: SoulRipper: rips the music, jingles and sound effects of a NES or Game Boy ROM to VGM.

options.name: --profile
options.description: curated profile: how to reach a playable state, sound names

options.name: --keep-suspect
options.description: also write sounds past the game's valid IDs

options.name: --offline
options.description: do not look the game up online

options.name: --jobs
options.description:
worker processes (default: cores - 1)
advanced:
soulripper discover <rom> --out report.json [--queues A460,A468] [--extra 04F5] [--no-rebase]
soulripper bench <rom> [--frames N]
soulripper access <rom> --addr A460,A470 [--frames N]
